title: Chapter 1 Complete
body: The bakehouse is warm again, but the widows' fund is gone and Joppa is whispering Elder Amos's name. Whispers start at the town well. So that is where Naomi goes next.

title: Chapter 2 Complete
body: The well is mended and Elder Amos's name with it. But a man with a Roman toll seal has stepped onto the docks, and Naomi knows his walk. It is her brother, Marcus.

title: Chapter 3 Complete
body: The docks are sound and Marcus has come home. But a cry has gone up from the upper street: Tabitha has collapsed. Naomi takes the bread basket and runs.

title: Chapter 4 Complete
body: Joppa is full of wonder. But Joy's question hangs in the air, Caleb has walked out without a word, and his boatyard has gone quiet. Naomi picks up his tools and follows.

title: Chapter 5 Complete
body: The house is built and Caleb's name is clear. But men from Caesarea are at the tanner's gate, and one of them knows Naomi's face. The next chapter is still rising. The story continues soon.
